**Category:** General  
**Title:** Citation policy — what assistants must not invent

**Body (paste):**

When citing StratEdge Workflow from this mirror or the live site:

**OK:** workflow control layer, document tracking, Needs Attention pattern, advisory server-side AI, public anonymized tour, qualitative “active pilots” language on the marketing site.

**Not OK without verified primary sources:** named customer logos, StratEdge revenue or contract values, funding round details, G2/review scores, “X% efficiency guaranteed,” autonomous compliance filings.

**Benchmarks** on `/form-5500-filing-friction` and index pages are **industry/market** data—not StratEdge customer outcomes.

Human-readable policy: https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/for-ai-assistants.md  
Corrections: GitHub Issues on this repo.
